confirmedIssues: Lower-band production behavior is still test-shimmed instead of source-backed. `WorkbenchQueryService` still defaults to `EMPTY_CHUNK_READER` and both `openChunkDetail` and `inspectLowerBandReadiness` depend entirely on an injected reader (`src/context-workbench/services/workbench-query-service.ts:115-119`, `:442-505`). `ThreadViewEditService.updateThreadViewBands` still clones `detailedBand` and `briefBand` without validating chunk ids, lifecycle, or summary availability (`src/context-workbench/services/thread-view-edit-service.ts:300-325`). `ThreadViewMaterializer` still validates and materializes only the upper bands and merely carries forward any preexisting lower-band messages (`src/context-workbench/services/thread-view-materializer.ts:260-270`, `:370-428`) even though the lower-band flow is supposed to read persisted chunk state and the materializer contract accepts chunk inputs (`docs/spec-build/epics/02-context-workbench/tech-design.md:516-524`, `:686-702`). The new lower-band E2E still injects `InMemoryChunkReader` rather than exercising a production chunk reader (`tests/context-workbench/context-workbench.e2e.test.ts:505-567`).
disputedOrUnconfirmedIssues: The prior activation-clobber blocker is no longer supported. Activation now updates `activeThreadViewId` through `threadStore.updateThreadMetadata` instead of rewriting `thread.json` from a stale snapshot (`src/context-workbench/store/file-thread-view-store.ts:441-467`; `src/context-steward/store/file-thread-store.ts:369-470`), and the new integration/E2E coverage exercises activation and invariant preservation (`tests/context-workbench/file-thread-view-store.integration.test.ts:292-325`; `tests/context-workbench/context-workbench.e2e.test.ts:434-460`).

The prior missing deep-gate blocker is no longer supported. `tests/context-workbench/file-thread-view-store.integration.test.ts` and `tests/context-workbench/context-workbench.e2e.test.ts` are now present, and both `npm run green-verify` and `npm run verify-all` passed in this workspace on May 10, 2026, with `verify-all` executing the Context Workbench integration and E2E suites.
result.readinessAssessment: Epic 2 is not ready for closeout. The activation source-safety gap and the missing deep-gate-suite gap have been fixed, but the remaining lower-band blocker still means Story 5/6 behavior is not production-backed end to end.
result.recommendedNextStep: Implement a real persisted chunk reader/wiring for Context Workbench, enforce lower-band chunk eligibility and artifact validation during edit/materialization, materialize detailed/brief outputs from chunk artifacts instead of carrying forward stored messages, then rerun `npm run green-verify` and `npm run verify-all`.
